## Phase 9: Bounded Live Acceptance And Independent Review

**Goal**: Produce fresh semantic evidence from exactly three bounded non-repository live modes after deterministic cost preflight and any required approval, then hand the final unmodified evidence set to an independent reviewer.

**Execution Details**:

- Live-run record: `library/packs/technical-docs/tests/manual-agent-e2e.md`.
- Exercised entry point: the installed projection of `library/packs/technical-docs/agents/dude-pack-technical-docs-writer.agent.md`.
- Modes: transcript-only; mixed transcript, notes, and draft with no repository Source; and existing-document update from a prior generated document plus new transcript evidence.
- Preflight per mode: before model calls, report source count, extraction-unit count, approximate tokens, expected model calls and batches, and ETA.
- Approval threshold: pause before extraction and obtain explicit user approval when a mode projects more than 20 extraction units or model calls, or more than 10 minutes.
- Evidence per completed mode: full canonical source, unit, ledger, semantic-review, final-coverage, final-lint, output-hash, and mode-specific traceability evidence.
- Reuse boundary: transcript-only evidence may be reused only when complete and hash-current; `tech-expanded-output.md` is user delivery, not canonical update-mode evidence.
- Deferral: repository-only live acceptance is separate future bounded or scoped repository work; repository runtime and automated repository coverage remain unchanged.
- Observable verification: all three records are complete and current, every final gate passes against the reviewed output, and the independent reviewer approves the same final unmodified evidence set.

**Independent Test**: Each bounded live mode passes preflight and any required approval, produces a traceable finalized document under its source contract, and is represented in the final unmodified evidence set independently reviewed without unresolved rejection.
